CustomField.description: Presents this Field Set section as a survey: each question sits in its own frame, one question is in focus at a time and choosing an answer moves to the next (#889). Set per section so a form can mix survey questions with sections that are filled in together, such as contact details. Replaces the template-wide Survey Mode switch.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Show this section's questions one at a time, each in its own frame. Leave it off for sections people fill in together, such as contact details.
CustomField.label: Survey Section
